messages.subject: movemarker error
parts:
Hello group,

I would like to combine several singleton linkage groups into one. When I use the code below, only the last marker in the loop is in the newly created linkage group. I'm sure there is an error in my code but hitting my head on the desk hasn't fixed it. Any help would be greatly appreciated.

> two<-markernames(LG, chr=c(15,24,25,26,27,28,29))
> two
[1] "S2_3968758"  "S2_8980736"  "S2_1426584"  "S2_7808963"  "S2_8589811"
[6] "S2_10964348" "S2_17289914" "S2_34114044"
> for(mar in two)
+ data<-movemarker(LG, mar, 200)
> markernames(data, 200)
[1] "S2_34114044"

I have also tried movemarker with one marker at a time by hand and the same thing happens.

Thanks!

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] movemarker error
parts:
In the line

data <- movemarker(LG, mar, 200)

You're creating a new object "data" with mar moved to linkage group "200".
But then you're over-writing that each time.

Try:

two<-markernames(LG, chr=c(15,24,25,26,27,28,29))
LGrev <- LG
for(mar in two)
LGrev <- movemarker(LGrev, mar, 200)

karl
